description: Deterministic security scan (no model calls, nothing leaves the machine): routes, server actions, Supabase clients and queries, RLS policies. Returns findings with status likely/suppressed and the honest coverage statement. Run this first, then audit_get_context for a finding.

migrations.description: Extra directories with Supabase migration SQL, relative to the scanned path, when they are outside it (they must still be inside the project)

name: audit_scan
title: Scan a Next.js + Supabase project
